trickyParts: Lock order: document advisory lock (only when the caller already holds it) -> instance catch-up mutex -> state.mu; the follower takes the advisory lock only to confirm a replaced-history verdict, never while holding the catch-up mutex.

A live write stores the room's not-yet-stored updates in its own transaction ahead of its row (storeRoomUpdatesAhead), so the stored history is never a state the document did not hold; storedAt compares bytes because a rolled-back version number can be reused.

A browser append refused because the history was replaced fails the room (reload), not only a catch-up request: a catch-up request lost the edit wherever no room-sync lane runs (regression seed 1793084442294211495 added to twoProcessRegressionSeeds).
A cold agent write loads no room (finding 11); Shutdown may load a room only for a document whose settle timer was armed when it scanned, so a SIGTERM inside the settle delay still settles it.
deviations: Plan D2 named a room-sync listener of its own; on the INFRA-63 architect's rule (one listener connection per process) it is a shared pglisten.Hub (Handle/Wake/OnConnected/OnDisconnected/Run, agreed with INFRA-605 and INFRA-607); membership is its connection's application_name 'dispatch-listener <uuid>'.

A new notification channel dispatch_doc_head {r,v,p} is sent beside the bare-id dispatch_doc_changed (agreed with INFRA-605); the gate has the agreed shape queueAppendGate/gateAppend(room, through, appendKind).
Awareness queries ride dispatch_doc_awareness ({s,r,q:true}), not dispatch_doc_query, because nobody waits on their answers.

Migrations are 0135-0137 after the merge with main (main took 0121-0134); INFRA-559's branch also takes 0135-0136, and whichever merges second renumbers, and sets leasePoolSize 12 (both lease a new loop).
